def: Retrieving document pages by embedding their images directly, without first extracting text.
A retriever that encodes a page image into one vector per image patch with a vision-language model and scores pages by late interaction.
A small square of a page image that the vision model encodes into one vector.
Late-interaction scoring in which each query token takes its best-matching document vector and these best matches are summed.
An index that stores many vectors per document, such as one per token or patch, instead of a single vector.
A benchmark of page-level retrieval over visually rich documents, introduced with ColPali and extended in later versions.
Using a cheap first stage to propose candidates and an expensive scorer such as MaxSim to re-rank only those.
Merging neighbouring patch vectors to shrink a multi-vector index, at some cost in accuracy.
Returning whole pages as the retrieval unit, so a separate step is needed to locate or quote the evidence within the page.
